ModMetaData.name: Crop Cold Tolerance Overhaul
ModMetaData.author: sucRo0629
ModMetaData.description:
Beta release.
Separates crop minimum-growth temperature from cold-death behavior. Supported crops use either an explicit fixed cold-death temperature or cold dormancy below their minimum growth temperature, with the relevant temperature shown in the plant Info Card.
Includes Vanilla balance and optional Medieval Overhaul 1.6 balance. Nice Plants Menu compatibility is applied when that mod is present; Dubs Mint Menus works through the standard Info Card path.
CCTO can also be used as a lightweight XML-facing framework by other mods without replacing the plant class.
